description:
Coming from a big agency, an idol trainee for 7 years, Lee Dojoon, who suppose to debut as a leader in a new group had a big accident which happened during a music video shoot. After the incident, his debut got cancelled, and has been inactive for half a year.

Then suddenly, a miracle happened when he open his eyes...

[Collect 'likes' in SNS and get an item!]  
[Remaining time: 167:59:59]

Why am I suddenly hallucinating.

It's not like this is a webnovel, so why am I suddenly seeing a status window?  
If that happen then it would be better to go back to when my debut got cancelled.

[00:00:00]  
[Time's up.]

Then, an ominous bright sentence appeared in front of him.

[The system is shutting down.]

If you want to live, receive 'likes'!  
Hopeful to become an idol, Dojoon is entering the entertainment business anxiously!
